changes: Normal attendance choices exclude leave and holiday; saved marks remain readable, with leave managed in HR Leave.
HR Calendar has Add Holiday with paid day-off defaults. Holidays use amber date headers and indicators; regular days off remain gray.
Approved leave is visible over ordinary zero-minute defaults. Future holidays remain identifiable without counting as elapsed attendance.
HR Attendance refreshes compatible partial drafts from saved payroll and provides Reload Saved Attendance with protection for unsaved changes.
